figureAlts.figure5.gif: Two histograms are shown. The first histogram on the left has the x-axis labeled as Outcomes, ranging from 0 to 30, and the y-axis labeled as Percent per unit, ranging from 0 to 20. The distribution is centered around 5, with most values between 0 and 10. The second histogram on the right has the same x-axis and y-axis labels, with the y-axis ranging from 0 to 25. The distribution is centered around 15, with most values between 10 and 20.
